requirements.statement: A merchant can sign up and submit verification details to start the KYC review process

criteria.must: A prospective merchant can submit business name, country and an identifying document
A newly submitted merchant has a pending KYC status and cannot yet accept payments
Only Nigeria, Kenya or Ghana can be selected as the merchant's country

requirements.statement: A merchant can sign in securely via single sign-on to access their dashboard

criteria.must: A merchant signs in through the platform's single sign-on and lands on their dashboard
An unauthenticated visitor cannot reach the merchant dashboard

requirements.statement: A merchant can generate a hosted checkout link or integrate a checkout API to accept payments on their own site

criteria.must: An active merchant can view a hosted checkout link for their business
An active merchant can view API credentials for integrating checkout on their own site

requirements.statement: A merchant can view a list of their transactions with status and details

criteria.must: A merchant can view a list of only their own business's transactions
Each listed transaction shows its amount, payment method and status
A merchant cannot view another merchant's transactions

requirements.statement: A merchant can configure their payout bank account or mobile wallet

criteria.must: A merchant can enter and save a bank account or mobile wallet as their payout destination
The saved payout account is used for the merchant's subsequent payouts

requirements.statement: A merchant can view their scheduled payouts and payout history

criteria.must: A merchant can view a history of their own payouts with amount and status
Payouts are shown on a weekly schedule

requirements.statement: A merchant can issue a refund to a customer for a completed transaction

criteria.must: A merchant can refund a completed transaction belonging to their own business
A refunded transaction's status changes to refunded
A merchant cannot refund another merchant's transaction

requirements.statement: A merchant can see a dashboard summary of sales, fees and payouts

criteria.must: The merchant dashboard shows a summary of recent sales
The merchant dashboard shows platform fees charged
The merchant dashboard shows upcoming or recent payout information

requirements.statement: A platform admin can review and approve or reject merchant onboarding applications

criteria.must: An admin can view a queue of merchants pending KYC review
An admin can approve a pending merchant, activating it
An admin can reject a pending merchant, preventing it from accepting payments

requirements.statement: A platform admin can monitor transactions across all merchants for suspicious activity

criteria.must: An admin can view transactions across every merchant, not only one
An admin can filter the transaction list by merchant and by status

requirements.statement: A platform admin can configure the platform's transaction fee rate

criteria.must: An admin can view the current platform fee percentage
An admin can update the platform fee percentage

requirements.statement: A platform admin can manage and trigger merchant payout runs on a weekly schedule

criteria.must: An admin can trigger a payout run covering eligible merchants
A triggered payout run produces a payout record per eligible merchant

requirements.statement: A platform admin can view and resolve disputes raised against merchant transactions

criteria.must: An admin can view every open dispute across merchants
An admin can record a resolution and close a dispute

requirements.statement: A platform admin can suspend or deactivate a merchant account

criteria.must: An admin can suspend an active merchant
A suspended merchant can no longer accept new payments

requirements.statement: A customer can pay a merchant using mobile money or a card at checkout

criteria.must: A customer can complete a checkout payment using mobile money
A customer can complete a checkout payment using a card
Checkout can be completed without first creating an account

requirements.statement: A customer can create an account and save payment methods for faster future checkouts

criteria.must: A customer can create an account
A signed-in customer can save a payment method to their account
A signed-in customer can view their previously saved payment methods

requirements.statement: A customer receives a payment confirmation or receipt after paying

criteria.must: A customer sees an on-screen payment confirmation immediately after a successful payment
A customer receives an email receipt after a successful payment

requirements.statement: A signed-in customer can view their payment history across merchants

criteria.must: A signed-in customer can view a list of their own past payments across different merchants
A customer cannot view another customer's payment history

requirements.statement: A customer can raise a dispute on a transaction, and a platform admin mediates the resolution with the merchant

criteria.must: A signed-in customer can raise a dispute on one of their own payments
A raised dispute appears in the platform admin's dispute queue
